Hate, discrimination and abuse of rights
Life Image coarse layout, basemap seriation_v0 (circular seriation)

16 sectors (inner ring) and 247 fields. Angle: circular seriation (ring order maximising adjacent similarity, displacement from the axes priced). Radial band: judged advanced/specialised score (dashed rings at 0.25 steps). Width: domain pressure (synthetic sample, provisional). Colour: main sector.
